title: Unknown entity: rest of the chunk is lost, parser restarts as a bare document, the 2nd next event disconnects
notes: Observed with lxml 6.1.3 / libxml2 2.14.6 (an01/work/probes/entity_quirk_probe.py, dev01 quirk_unknown_entity_restart): after '&foo;' libxml2 discards the rest of that feed() chunk (M-2 lost), then re-parses as a bare document without <root>: the next top-level element (M-3) becomes the document element and is emitted, the one after (M-4) raises 'Extra content at the end of the document' -> disconnect. Chunk = one recv(4096) after XMLDeclStrip, so over real TCP the outcome depends on segmentation. D-23: Rust drops only the enclosing event and keeps parsing (ADR-002).
